curriculumHighlights.text: IIITA's B.Tech Ordinance-2023 (NEP-aligned, effective AY 2023-24) sets a 160-credit, 8-semester degree that pairs a core Major with a mandatory 15-credit multidisciplinary Minor; a Double Major option is planned for a future rollout.

sources.title: IIIT-A: The Ordinance-2023 for B.Tech Program with NEP Aligned Curriculum - Sections 3(d)-(f), 4.0-4.11 (160 credits, Major + Mandatory Minor)

curriculumHighlights.text: An optional B.Tech Honours needs 15 extra credits in the student's own branch, a minimum 8.0 CGPI with no backlog, an academic 8th-semester project, and at least one Tier-I/II or SCI publication (or a filed patent).

sources.title: IIIT-A: The Ordinance-2023 for B.Tech Program - Section 5(g) Honors eligibility

curriculumHighlights.text: NEP-style multiple exits let a student leave with a UG Certificate after year 1 (40 credits), a UG Diploma after year 2 (80 credits), or a B.Sc.(Engineering) after year 3 (120 credits), each needing a few additional prescribed credits.

sources.title: IIIT-A: The Ordinance-2023 for B.Tech Program - Section 4.21 Honorable Exit Options

curriculumHighlights.text: Grading is a 60:40 continuous-assessment split: a 35-mark formative Part-1 (quizzes/assignments/labs), a 25-mark mid-semester exam, and a 40-mark end-semester exam, converted to a relative A+-to-F letter grade on a 10-point scale.

sources.title: IIIT-A: The Ordinance-2023 for B.Tech Program - Sections 5 and 14.0 Marks Distribution and Grading System

curriculumHighlights.text: 75% attendance is compulsory in every course or the student is deregistered from it; a student may register for at most 28 credits (backlog plus current courses) in a semester.

sources.title: IIIT-A: The Ordinance-2023 for B.Tech Program - Sections 9 and 14.6 Attendance Requirements

curriculumHighlights.text: A one-time branch change is allowed at the end of semester 1, open only to students who cleared every first-semester course with an SGPI of 7.50 or above; it depends on seats in the target branch and ignores category/reservation.

sources.title: IIIT-A: The Ordinance-2023 for B.Tech Program - Section 17 Branch Change

curriculumHighlights.text: Up to 40% of credits in a course type may come from NPTEL/SWAYAM online courses (up to 5% as self-study credit); the normal 4-year degree can extend via spill-over semesters 9-12, up to 6 years for General/OBC and 7 years for SC/ST/PwD students.

sources.title: IIIT-A: The Ordinance-2023 for B.Tech Program - Sections 6(l), 8 and 5(j) online courses, duration, spill-over semesters

curriculumHighlights.text: A CGPI of 8.50 or above earns the B.Tech degree 'with Distinction'; only students who finish all 160 credits within the first 8 successive semesters remain eligible for institute ranks, medals and merit-based fellowships.

sources.title: IIIT-A: The Ordinance-2023 for B.Tech Program - Section 5(h) Distinction and 5(j) Ranks/Medals

research.note: Research runs through five institute centres alongside the four departments: the Center for Cognitive Computing, the Center for Intelligent Robotics, the Rekhi Center for Science of Happiness, the Center for Continuing Education and Outreach Program, and a NewGen IEDC innovation cell. Each department runs its own Ph.D. programme (IT; ECE; Applied Sciences, spanning Bioinformatics, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics and Statistics; and Management Studies), and IT also offers a combined M.Tech-Ph.D. track. IIITA's own pages do not publish a current headcount of enrolled scholars.
